name: VoxelPLA
summary: Southern California filament brand that grew out of a ~250-machine production print farm: the operator says it developed its own materials after finding other brands inadequate at volume, and still runs the farm exclusively on its own filament as a QA testbed. Catalogue is narrow and high-speed focused — PLA+ HS, PETG+ HS and Galaxy sparkle versions of both — sold at aggressive prices, plus a small line of Bambu-ecosystem filtration and anti-vibration accessories. VoxelPLA is UNRELATED to Voxelab: despite the similar 'Voxel' naming they are separate companies with no corporate, ownership or supply link.

product_lines.name: VOXEL PLA+ HS (Pro)
product_lines.notes: 1.75 mm toughened PLA marketed for high-speed printing, ~27 colours. pla-plus is the primary chemistry; pla-hf is listed for the high-speed claim, which no TDS independently confirms.

product_lines.name: VOXEL GALAXY PLA+ HS (Pro)
product_lines.notes: Sparkle/galaxy-effect version of the PLA+ HS base (Midnight Blue, Emerald Gold, Gioiello Purple, Aurora Green); glitter-particle PLA.

product_lines.name: VOXEL PETG+ HS (Pro)
product_lines.notes: High-speed-marketed enhanced PETG in 11 colours; mapped to petg-plus on the brand's own '+' designation, with no disclosed chemistry departure from base PETG.

product_lines.name: VOXEL GALAXY PETG+ HS (Pro)
product_lines.notes: Sparkle version of the PETG+ HS base; the catalog has no glitter PETG id, so the base line's id is reused.

additional_notes: UNRELATED TO VOXELAB: Voxelab (voxelab3dp.com) is a Flashforge-affiliated Chinese printer and resin hardware sub-brand; VoxelPLA is an independent Southern California filament maker. Neither VoxelPLA's homepage, About Us page nor any product page mentions Voxelab or Flashforge, and searches for a link returned nothing — the only connection is the shared 'Voxel' string, and the two entries must not be merged or cross-referenced as related companies. Pricing is $16.99 per 1 kg for standard PLA+/PETG+, $24.99 for the Galaxy sparkle line and $98.99 for bundles, undercutting most US-made filament, hence price_tier budget despite the domestic manufacturing claim. Accessories are filtration and vibration damping rather than build surfaces — VOXEL Bento Box 2-Stage Filter ($39.99), HULA Anti-Vibration Damper Feet (from $9.99), Bambu Lab X-Filter compatible part (from $5.99), Bambu Lab P2S VentoBox 2-Stage Filter ($39.99), Bambu Lab Vento H2 Series 2-Stage Filter ($29.99) — so makes_plates is false. The 'engineered and manufactured in the United States' claim is the company's own and is not independently corroborated.

provenance.conflicts: US manufacturing is a self-claim with no plant address, resin supplier or third-party confirmation. No legal entity name was found. The similar naming to Voxelab (Flashforge) invites confusion; searches found no relationship, so the brands are recorded as unrelated, but the absence of a link is evidence of absence only to the depth searched.
